description: Edit this sheet of eight small chibi pixel art figures: the top row walks towards the viewer, the bottom row walks away from the viewer. Dress every figure in the same outfit and change nothing else: keep each figure's pose, size, place, bald head, ears and face exactly as they are, with the same chunky pixel size, the same thick dark outline and the same flat shading with a few tones per colour. The outfit: a turquoise shirt with one large red flower on each front panel, knotted over a white top, sand shorts and white canvas shoes. Seen from behind: a turquoise shirt with one large red flower, sand shorts and white shoes. Simple bold shapes, no fine pattern. The hands stay bare. Transparent background, nothing else added.
